acceptance_summary.backend_loss: Live backend stop during active movement; stationary pose and zero cmd_vel after timeout; backend restart returned idle without old run.

acceptance_summary.recovery: Supervisor reset with next generation plus backend restart restored health; old run did not resume.

remaining_limits: Independent odom/scan loss lacks live topic injection and is supported by deterministic ROS callback lease tests.
The exact first zero cmd_vel after backend death was not timestamped live; deterministic watchdog lease bound is tested at 0.5 seconds.
The LLM hang was exercised at the planner boundary, not by blackholing a live remote network request.

A stopped simulation container restarted out-of-band at generation 0 while backend expected a higher generation; this correctly remained disconnected until explicit supervisor generation reset/backend handshake. Automatic recovery is not supported.
